{{Quote|I had the third, fourth, and seventh fleets from the D'Astan sector hiding behind Orinda's moon.|[[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]]|<ref name="CE3.6" />}}
'''Orinda's moon''' was the natural satellite of the planet [[Orinda/Legends|Orinda]].

==History==
In [[13 ABY/Legends|13 ABY]],<ref name="Back in the Red">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/crimsonempire3/index.html|text=Back in the Red: Dark Horse Comics Announces Long-Awaited Crimson Empire III Series}}</ref> the fleets of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Ragez D'Asta]] ambushed the forces of the [[Restored Empire]] by hiding behind the moon during a [[Battle of Orinda (13 ABY)|battle]] there.<ref name="CE3.6" />
